lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The centroids are arranged in a staggered grid pattern with increasing spatial intervals as they progress toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, creating a grid where the high-luminance blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge to a shadow-defined gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible beneath the ventral-lateral area of the shark.
